text: I've tested a bunch of habit tracking apps but this is by far my favourite, mainly for it's simplicity. However, the UX is a bit cluncky. The action notification is shown at the bottom of the screen where it blocks the calendar, you then have to wait 5 seconds to interact with the calendar again. Also, some habits fail to update when switching between dates. Taping out and in again on a date usually refreshes the values but I wish it just worked. This app would be perfect for me otherwise 🙏
author: Nicolas Gutierrez
developer_reply: Thanks, Nicolas! Love that the simplicity works for you. Sorry about the toast blocking the calendar and the date-switch refresh bug. We’re on it. Please email contact@habitify.me. Suggestions: feedback.habitify.me 🙏

text: Very useful app. Developers works every day to improve its value.
